business.shop_blurb: BearChart is built and run by Jay's Retro Exchange. Browse what is in stock, or send us a collection and we will make an offer on it.
business.shop_disclosure: We buy and sell the same items this guide values. No valuation on this site is adjusted because of it - the numbers come from recorded sold transactions, and you can see every one of them.
business.blurb: We buy Build-A-Bear collections. The range below is what we would pay, calculated from the same sold data shown on this page.
business.disclosure: Jay's Retro Exchange buys and sells Build-A-Bear items, and would be buying this one from you. Our offer is generated from the same public sold-comp data you can see above - we do not adjust a valuation because we want to buy it.
